last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 fresh knee osteoarthritis self-management topics, all classified as non-prescription candidates. The final query set returned 190 unique PubMed PMIDs, 190 article IDs requested, 189 fetched article records, and 189 abstracts available for inspection because one requested record was absent from the returned NCBI XML. Retained numeric intervention-versus-control results or valid relative effects were verified for PMID records: 33591346, 28733093, 41143827, 19389743, 39169515, 28426917, 33174383, 28437570, 34826572, 30002395, 40906756, 20177839, 26822714, 39212129, 35024906, 23904246, 35880828, 37706609, 33843948, 40816302, and 30967128. Twenty-one PubMed references were added across 21 new entries. New entries cover strength training, hydrotherapy, online Tai Chi, Tai Chi qigong, aquatic exercise, internet cognitive behavioral therapy, electroacupuncture, acupressure, transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation, unloading and valgus knee braces, orthotics, undenatured type II collagen, oral collagen, glucosamine-chondroitin, vitamin D, krill oil, cryotherapy, telehealth exercise, gait retraining, and retro-walking. Exercise, aerobic exercise, resistance training, walking, Tai Chi, yoga, aquatic exercise, weight management, mindfulness, acupuncture, massage, heat therapy, glucosamine-chondroitin, collagen, turmeric, and omega-3 topics were linked to existing knee osteoarthritis evidence entries where applicable. Mediterranean diet, anti-inflammatory diet, and low-carbohydrate diet were screened out because the selected PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control magnitude or valid relative effect. One new internet cognitive behavioral therapy comparison warning and one legacy knee-brace comparison warning were fixed before the final build. Two truthful thin-study warnings remain for the 44-person Tai Chi qigong study and the 46-person valgus-brace study, in addition to the prior thin-study backlog.
